# GM-437: skip embedding noise (generated files, trivial nodes)

Design slice S1 of GM-437, release 4.16.0. Data from the six GM-398 eval
snapshots (`eval/embedding/work/<corpus>.sqlite`, the exact node sets the
GM-398 runs ranked). No indexing or embedding was run for this note.
Scripts: scratchpad `gm437/{classes,residual,split,ruleA}.py` (read-only
sqlite over the snapshots).

## Today

- **What is embedded.** Every node for which `embedding::text::text_to_embed(doc, signature)`
  is `Some`: a non-blank doc comment or a non-blank signature. Kind, name,
  path and body size play no part. The text is the trimmed doc comment
  (ADR 0012), a blank line, then the signature. The body is never embedded.
- **Who decides.** `EmbeddingPipeline::compute` (`core/src/embedding/pipeline.rs:429`)
  filters `diff.upsert_nodes` through `text_to_embed`. Its callers:
  `embedding::backfill::run` (`backfill.rs:167`, cold start and model change),
  `watcher::apply` (`apply.rs:956`, edits), `daemon::workspace_reindex`
  (`workspace_reindex.rs:448`, fed by `storage::language_swap::plan_embeddings`).
  `EmbeddingPipeline::store` re-checks via `current_embeddable_text` (`pipeline.rs:775`).
  Backfill's candidate SQL (`count_candidates`, `fetch_candidate_page`) is
  `docComment IS NOT NULL OR signature IS NOT NULL`.
  Two callers build a filler `NodeRecord` with only id/doc/signature:
  `backfill::to_node_record` and `language_swap::plan_embeddings` (kind, name and path are `""`).
- **Generated files.** `walk` honours `.gitignore` (no global gitignore) plus
  each plugin's `exclude_dirs`: baseline `.git .claude`; Rust `target`; Go
  `vendor testdata`; TS `node_modules dist`; Python `.venv venv __pycache__ .tox
  .mypy_cache site-packages node_modules`. Lockfiles are never nodes, because no plugin
  claims their extensions. There is no "generated file" marker check anywhere.
- **search_code** ranks only `vectors JOIN nodes` (`search_code.rs:228`): a node
  without a vector is invisible to it but still found by every structural tool.

## Data (six eval corpora, 15,625 embeddable nodes, ~475 gold expectations)

Generated files, scanned by header marker (`Code generated`, `DO NOT EDIT`,
`@generated`, `autogenerated`, `generated by`) over every source file:

| corpus | marked files | embeddable nodes in them |
|---|---|---|
| excalidraw | 4 (font index.ts x2, harfbuzz/woff2 wasm) | 0 |
| gin | `testdata/protoexample/test.pb.go` | 0 (`testdata` excluded already) |
| py-requests | `docs/conf.py` (sphinx-quickstart "autogenerated", hand-edited since) | 34 |
| ripgrep | `complete/zsh.rs` (false hit in prose) | 2 |
| g-mesh, ttm | none | 0 |

**Generated-file share is about 0%. That lever cannot be measured on this eval.**

Trivial nodes, by candidate rule (undocumented nodes only; "gold" = eval
expected answers the rule would drop):

| rule | pooled nodes dropped | text chars | gold dropped |
|---|---|---|---|
| fn body <= 3 lines | 1,885 (12.1%) | - | 24 (gin `IRoutes.*` one-line interface methods, py `__call__`...) |
| undoc const/var | 374 (2.4%) | - | 9 (`fnv::Hasher::PRIME`, `DEFAULT_PORTS`...) |
| one-line type | 113 (0.7%) | - | 5 |
| **name-only text**: signature has no identifier but the name (after keywords) | 2,556 (16.4%) | 2.5% | 14 (`struct BulkRun`-style types, `wireShutdownButton()`, `App#render`) |
| name-only, split by: Module decl (`pub mod x`) | 421 (2.7%) | 0.18% | 0 |
| ... test (test path or `test*` name) | 587 (3.8%) | 0.53% | 0 |
| ... inside a Rust inline `tests` module (`::tests::` in qualifiedName) | +975 (6.2%) | +1.3% | 0 |
| ... other Function / Type / Variable | 1,547 (9.9%) | 1.7% | 14 |

Per corpus, rule **N** below (name-only AND (module decl OR test)): ttm 8/157
(5.1%), excalidraw 32/2758 (1.2%), ripgrep 578/3428 (16.9%), g-mesh
1166/6774 (17.2%), gin 69/1547 (4.5%), py-requests 131/961 (13.6%):
**1,984 of 15,625 (12.7%) vectors, 2.0% of text chars, 0 gold.**

Reading: body size is the wrong signal. One-line *declarations* (interface
methods, constants) are public API and eval answers. What carries no extra
information is a text that is just the name. Of those, only module declarations
and tests are safe on this eval. A name-only text still carries the name's words
(`wireShutdownButton`), and the eval targets 14 of them.

## Filter rule (recommended: N)

Skip embedding a node when all of these hold:
1. no doc comment survives (`doc` blank), and
2. the signature's identifiers, minus language keywords (`pub crate super in fn mod
   const static struct enum func def async let export self mut var type impl
   unsafe extern`), are at most one (the name itself), and
3. either `kind == "Module"`, or the node is a test: its file matches the
   test-path pattern (`(^|/)(tests?|__tests__|testdata)/`, `_test.go`,
   `test_*.py`, `_tests?.rs`, `.test./.spec.` js/ts), or its name starts with
   `test`/`Test`, or its qualifiedName contains `::tests::` / starts `tests::`.

Dropped: `pub mod semantic`, `mod tests`, `fn test_trim()`,
`fn an_escalated_shutdown_says_so()` in `cli/stop.rs`'s `tests` module, `def test_invalid(self)`.
Kept: `fn pid(&self) -> u32` (`u32` is a second identifier), `IRoutes.PATCH(...)`, `const STRUCTURAL: u8`,
`struct BulkRun`, `getDateTime()`, any documented node.

### Options

| option | drops | benefit | risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| **N (recommended)** | 12.7% vectors, 0 gold | biggest cut with no eval loss | a descriptively named test (`a_nested_mod_rs_..._parent_chain`) stops being reachable by search_code. The eval has no test targets, so it cannot see that loss |
| N without the `::tests::` clause | 6.5%, 0 gold | does not touch tests in Rust source files | half the cut |
| all name-only | 16.4%, 14 gold | largest cut | measurable recall loss (types, TS functions) |
| G: generated-file marker | ~0% here | protects real repos with checked-in protobuf/codegen | needs file content, which the embedding stage never sees. It belongs in the plugins' walk and would drop the file structurally too. Nothing to measure on this eval: **defer to its own task** |

Expected cost effect: vectors and `vectors` table -12.7% (768 x 4 B each). Pass
time lies between the char share (2%) and the count share (12.7%), because
dropped texts are 3-10 tokens and per-call overhead dominates at batch size 1.
The measure slice settles it.

## Where it applies: embedding stage, one predicate

`walk` cannot apply rule N: it works on files, and N works on nodes. Add to
`core/src/embedding/text.rs`:

```rust
pub(crate) struct EmbedInput<'a> { kind, name, qualified_name, file_path, doc, signature: Option<&'a str> }
pub(crate) fn is_noise(input: &EmbedInput) -> bool          // rule N
pub(crate) fn node_text(input: &EmbedInput) -> Option<String> // None if is_noise, else text_to_embed(doc, sig)
```

`text_to_embed` stays the text *form* (eval `structured`, the reranker windows,
the digest test). `node_text` decides **whether** a node has a vector. The text
of a kept node is unchanged, so `TEXT_FORM_TAG` is **not** bumped: a bump would
re-embed every node on upgrade, a full pass when the cache is cold. Stale
vectors of now-filtered nodes are deleted instead (below).

**search_code for a filtered node:** absent from results and from the
semantic rung, like an undocumented signature-less node today. `find_definition`,
`get_file_outline`, `find_references` and callers are unchanged. The name-only rungs of
the resolution ladder still find it by name.

## Behaviours for the tests slice

- An undocumented `pub mod x` node gets no vector. A documented module keeps its vector.
- An undocumented zero-arg fn in `tests/foo.rs` gets no vector. The same fn in `src/foo.rs`, named `run`, keeps its vector.
- A fn under `crate::m::tests::` with name-only signature gets no vector. One with a param keeps its vector.
- `fn pid(&self) -> u32`, undocumented, keeps its vector (second identifier).
- A one-line interface method `PATCH(string, ...HandlerFunc) IRoutes` keeps its vector.
- Backfill on an index holding a vector for a now-filtered node deletes that vector. A second backfill embeds nothing and deletes nothing.
- A watcher edit that removes a node's doc comment and arguments (now noise) deletes its vector. The reverse edit embeds it.
- `plan_embeddings` marks a node that turned into noise as `text_changed`, and the swap leaves it with no vector.
- `store`'s staleness check uses `node_text`: a computed vector for a node that turned into noise meanwhile is not stored.
- `search_code` never returns a filtered node. `find_definition` by its name still does.
- `the_text_form_tag_is_pinned_to_the_text_format` digest is unchanged (no tag bump).
- Eval: the `filter = "noise"` arm's manifest `nodeCount` equals the snapshot's embeddable count minus `is_noise` count. A gold on a filtered node scores as a miss, not as a harness error.

## Measurement protocol (measure slice)

- Arms: R = `jina-v2-base-code-fp32`, R+N = `jina-v2-base-code-fp32-noise`, same six snapshots, same release build.
- Quality: `debug-embed-eval run` both arms, all six corpora. `report` with paired bootstrap (seed 398, 10,000 resamples, per language). Report recall@10 and MRR pooled and per corpus, plus false alarm and confident-wrong. Floors refitted per arm, as D6 does.
- Cost: `G_MESH_EMBEDDING_CACHE=off /usr/bin/time -lp g-mesh debug-embed-eval run --variant <v> --corpus <c> --embed-only --force`, on g-mesh and ripgrep (the two corpora with the largest cut), 3 rounds interleaved R, R+N. Report median `embedNodesMs`, max RSS, vector count, `vectors.bin` bytes.
- Machine state per run: `uptime` before and after, `user`/`sys`/`real`. user/real near 3.9 means no stall. Wait for the GM-644 load gate.
- **Cheap observation telling the arms apart:** each run's `manifest.json` `nodeCount` and `nodeIdsSha256`. g-mesh R = 6,774, R+N = 5,608. ripgrep 3,428 vs 2,850. If equal, the arm measured nothing.
- One script, background, fail-fast, compact summary file.

## Must confirm

1. Owner: rule N with the `::tests::` clause (12.7%), or without it (6.5%)? Is dropping test functions from `search_code` acceptable, given the eval has no test targets and cannot show that loss?
2. Owner: defer the generated-file filter to its own task? The eval corpora contain none, so its effect cannot be measured here.
3. Production default weights are `int8` (`model.rs` `DEFAULT_WEIGHTS_TAG`). The task asks for fp32 (R). Add an int8 cost round?
4. Impl: is `compute` returning the dropped ids (`ComputedBatch`) the right shape, or should `store` derive them from the diff? (Four call sites either way.)
5. Measure: confirm that harness gold resolution reads the full snapshot, not the candidate set (`embed_eval.rs` resolver), before the arm runs.
6. Pass-time gain may be small (2-13%). Agree before measuring that "vectors -12.7% at 0 recall loss" alone ships the feature.
